title: Pick a theme
notes: A new Theme button at the top of the page offers Zephyr (the city’s own purple, now the default), Slate (the guide’s earlier teal look), Light, Midnight (pure black), Nord, Dracula, Solarized Dark and Light, and High contrast.
Choose Match my device to follow your phone or PC’s dark or light setting. Your pick is saved on this device.

title: A What's new button so you can see what changed
notes: This list. The badge on What's new counts the changes you have not opened yet.

title: Search, shareable links and a crafting plan that sticks around
notes: Search the guide for a recipe, guide, bench or postcode. Press / to start typing.
Every recipe, tier, guide and location has its own address, so you can send someone a link straight to it.
Your crafting plan is saved on your device and survives a refresh. There is a Clear plan button when you are done.
Adding to the plan shows a confirmation at the bottom of the screen with a View plan shortcut.
Photos load much faster, and on phones only the section menu stays pinned while you scroll.

title: Smelting overhaul
notes: Tell the smelter what you have or what you need. Quick amounts, a coal limit and an other-method switch make it faster to plan a run.
Each smelted item now shows where it is used across the guide.
The Smelting page matches the rest of the guide.

title: Scrap Yard gathering guide and Mainland 12 Gauge
notes: Gathering has a Scrap Yard guide with the postal 954 map.
12 Gauge joins the Mainland ammo recipes.

title: Metal Detecting guide and updated attachments
notes: Gathering has a Metal Detecting guide with the beach map.
Attachment recipes were updated and the Extended Rifle Clip was added.

title: Cayo ammo bench and the Gathering section
notes: The Cayo ammo bench has its map and photo, with a rob zone warning so you know the risk before you go.
A Gathering materials section with a tab for each method.

title: Heist crafting bench at postal 924
notes: Thermite Bomb, Big Bomb, C4 Explosive and Big Drill at the 924 bench in Harmony.
Silver smelting now uses Silver Ore.
Guide missing something? sends a Discord DM to uxmbra.

title: Weapon tiers and Cayo ammo
notes: Tier 1 (postal 817) and Tier 2 (postal 54) weapon recipes with bench photos and maps.
The Tier 3 bench at postal 2008 has its map and photo.
Ammo crafting is split into Mainland and Cayo, with all seven Cayo recipes.

title: Melee items, heist items and heist guides
notes: Melee recipes at the Chumash pier bench, postal 906.
Bolt Cutters, Thermite and the Electronic Kit under Heist items.
A Heist guides section that links to the items each job needs.

title: Cocaine guide
notes: A step-by-step Cocaine guide with island maps and the lab at postal 720.

title: A new look for the guide
notes: New layout, theme and buttons across the whole guide.

title: The guide goes live
notes: Ammo recipes, the smelter, attachments and business crafting, with the crafting calculator and plan.
